abort.already_configured: A vehicle with this license plate already exists.

user.title: New vehicle
user.description: Fill in the vehicle characteristics. The license plate must be unique.

data_description.name: How the vehicle appears in Home Assistant and in the card selector.
data_description.color: A color name (e.g. Red, Metallic blue) or a hex code. Also used for the 3D model.

documents.title: Documents and due dates
documents.description: Fill in the expiry dates. You can leave anything blank now and set it later straight from the UI.

data_description.revizie_km: Absolute odometer reading at which the service becomes due.
data_description.distributie_km: Absolute odometer reading at which the timing belt must be replaced.

media.title: Photo and 3D model
media.description: Upload a photo of the car. Optionally upload a 3D model (.glb or .gltf) that will be shown rotating in the card; without one, the card draws a stylized car in the vehicle color.

data_description.photo: Leave blank if you uploaded a file. /local/... paths are accepted.
data_description.model_3d: Leave blank if you uploaded a file. /local/... paths are accepted.

media.title: Photo and 3D model

mileage_source.title: Automatic mileage
mileage_source.description: Pick a sensor that reports the odometer (OBD adapter, the car maker's app, Android Auto...). The vehicle mileage is then updated automatically. Only increases are applied, so a wrong reading cannot lower it; miles and meters are converted to km. Clear the field to go back to manual mileage.

error.not_numeric: The selected entity does not report a number in km, mi or m.

set_document.name: Set document
set_document.description: Sets the expiry date and/or the due mileage for a document.

km.name: Due mileage
km.description: Only for service and timing belt.

renew_document.name: Renew document
renew_document.description: Extends a document by a number of months, starting from the current due date if it is in the future, otherwise from today.

months.name: Months
months.description: How many months the validity is extended by.

interval_km.name: Mileage interval
interval_km.description: Only for service and timing belt: added to the current mileage.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: Optional: also records the amount paid in the expense history.

mark_service_done.name: Mark work as done
mark_service_done.description: Records a service or timing belt replacement and computes the next due date automatically.

mileage.name: Mileage at completion
mileage.description: Falls back to the current mileage when omitted.

interval_months.name: Month interval
interval_months.description: How many months until the next due date.

interval_km.name: Mileage interval
interval_km.description: How many km until the next due date.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: Optional: also records the amount paid in the expense history.

add_expense.name: Add expense
add_expense.description: Records an expense in the vehicle's cost history.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: The amount paid, in the currency set in Home Assistant.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it was paid. Defaults to today.

mileage.name: Mileage
mileage.description: Optional: the odometer value at that moment.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional: details, e.g. the garage or the parts changed.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Only for fuel: litres (or kWh for electric cars) added.

full_tank.name: Full tank
full_tank.description: Only for fuel: the tank was filled up. Needed to calculate consumption.

delete_expense.name: Delete expense
delete_expense.description: Deletes an expense from the cost history.

expense_id.name: Expense id
expense_id.description: The id shown in the card or returned when the expense was added.
